metadata.description: A battle-tested skill for authoring, debugging, packaging and publishing QGIS Python plugins.

plugins.name: qgis-plugin
plugins.description: Author, debug, package and publish QGIS (3.x/4.x, PyQt5/PyQt6) Python plugins: dock/UI patterns, the runtime crash pitfalls that segfault QGIS, Qt5-to-Qt6 migration, the plugins.qgis.org security gates, a self-verifying manifest-driven build, local-deploy testing and the release flow.
